headline: The Spanish government changes the rules on housing renovation reforms from 1 December: reduces VAT under a new condition
summary: Spain's government is changing the rules on housing renovation reforms from 1 December, reducing VAT under a new condition. The change also sets out beneficiaries and types of work covered.
why: Housing renovation tax rules affect construction activity and household costs, which matter for building materials and residential construction companies.
